name: Question 8
worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{51}$, we remove the $5$th row and $1$st column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & -8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ ∗ & 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ ∗ & 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ ∗ & 0 & 6 & 8 & 3 \\ 11 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{51}=|\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 6 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${d}_{51}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{51} & =(-1)^{5+1}{M}_{51} \\  & ={M}_{51} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 6 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
